(critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: ORIGIN (iter-24): browser-qa UT-16 + UT-06 reproduced 2/2 on fresh restarts -- first cold GET /api/data load OOM-crashed the backend (MemoryError in cursor.fetchmany() prices.py:141 + json.dumps(), then a fatal PyO3 panic killing uvicorn; VmSize pinned at exactly 6144 MB ulimit -v while VmRSS ~2.9 GB = virtual-address-space exhaustion). Root cause: iter-24 item B added config.yaml mmap_size_bytes=1073741824 (1 GB per-connection read-mmap) x pool_size=10/max_overflow=20. RESOLVED (iter-25): the auditor's fix config.yaml:108 mmap_size_bytes=0 (mmap disabled; committed at HEAD 665565a) was re-verified LIVE by the canonical browser-qa lane -- UT-02/UT-03 stop->cold-start->/data-as-first-request 2/2 clean (~10.2s/10.5s, real content, backend survived); UT-06 confirms a single contained 'Backend unavailable' card on a genuinely-down backend, never a blank app-error page. Both gates that caught iter-24 cleared: UX-REGRESSION-PASS + CLOSURE-PASS. Remains resolved through iter-42 (prices.py/config.yaml git-untouched since; iter-42 perf re-measurement VmSize peak ~2,875MB, 53% margin). resolved=true.
